text:
Mira: Quick follow-up from the architecture sync: we still need a clear playbook for tenant-aware tiles + perf under high cardinality. Ideas?
Oscar: Short answer: don't break sharing unless we must. Longer: add a policy fingerprint to tile keys, but only include bits that actually affect query shape.
Priya: How do we compute the fingerprint cheaply? If it's per-tenant ruleset with thousands of flags we could pay a lot.
Dan: We can hash a stable canonicalization of policy subsets. e.g. include only (deny-list, column-exposure, sample-rate). Skip transient UI flags. Use sha256 and store first 16 hex chars.
Mira: OK. Two more constraints: 1) allow emergency global feature flips without invalidating all tiles; 2) allow per-tenant opt-outs.
Oscar: For (1) we version features separate from tile fingerprint and include feature_version in the tile metadata. That way a flip increments version but doesn't necessarily force new tiles unless it changes the fingerprint.
Priya: For opt-outs, console can mark route.allow_tile_sharing=false. Those tiles remain keyed by tenant (no sharing).
Dan: Implementation sketch: tile_key = sha256(base_key || policy_fingerprint) || "::v" || feature_version. We store fingerprint on the policy service and expose an API: GET /policy/fingerprint?tenant=123 -> abcdef012345
Mira: We should be careful about the cache explosion when many tenants share slight diffs. Suggest coalescing: if fingerprint collision rate is high, add a bucketed fallback that maps rare fingerprints to a shared degraded tile.
Oscar: Degraded tiles sound useful: cheap aggregates that are safe but lower fidelity. We already have precomputed aggregates for the degraded path.
Priya: Ops + metrics ask: expose metrics for tile_sharing_ratio and tile_by_fingerprint_count. That will show hot fingerprints and dispersion.
Dan: Also emit executor.tile_plan_reuse and tile.eviction_reason for debugging.
Mira: Rollout plan: feature flag behind console.feature.tile_fingerprint. Start with 50 tenants on staging, monitor p50/p95/p99 and tile_sharing_ratio. If p99 increases >10% or sharing_ratio drops >20% rollback.
Oscar: Add a chaos test: flip random feature_version for 5% of tenants and ensure no >2% error rate spike.
Priya: TTLs: allowlist cache entries should default to 60s with optional version param for instant invalidation on CI flows. Sensitive denies are enforced sync in executor.
Dan: We'll build an allowlist service with endpoints: POST /allowlist/{tenant}/{feature} (body: [keys...]) and GET with ?version=. Store in redis with buckets.
ci-bot: Integration tests: allowlist-service e2e passed (build #1287) :white_check_mark:
Mira: Action items: Oscar -> RFC addendum for tile-key canonicalization. Priya -> dashboards and alerts (tile_sharing_ratio, p99). Dan -> prototype allowlist service + TTL. I'll drive canary checklist and the staging run.
Oscar: Will ping when RFC is up.
Priya: I'll draft alert thresholds and escalate rules.
Dan: Prototyping this afternoon.
Mira: Thanks team :rocket:
